sourceFiles.pdf: SW Saga - Scavenger's Guide to Droids (optimized).pdf

process.discoveryMethod: Searched all 16,582 lines of supplied DJVU text for typed space, water, air, ground, speeder, tracked and starfighter vehicle headers, including special droid hybrids. Independently rendered all 162 original scanned PDF pages in eleven numbered contact sheets, plus high-resolution visual close read of printed p82 (one-based physical p83) to confirm the DP-2 chassis's vehicle-type line, CL, single identity, and neighboring droid action format. Other droid and customization sections surveyed for full independent vehicle-type blocks.
process.printedToPdfMapping: PDF zero-based index equals printed page; physical one-based ordinal equals printed +1
process.sourceDocumentTextSemantics: Printed original PDF page authoritative; DJVU text discovery only.
